slides.say: You show a notification in the current theme when the chat connects. Now theme is a dependency, and switching themes reconnects the chat.
Theme is read inside the Effect, so it must be a dependency. But a new theme should not mean a new connection.
Move that part into an Effect Event with use effect event. It always sees the latest theme, but it is not reactive. Leave it out of the dependencies.

slides.text: Effect Event = part of the Effect that behaves like an event handler.
slides.say: An Effect Event is part of your Effect logic that behaves like an event handler.
